title: Reduce per-frame coarse updates and throttle extraction to prevent stalls/freezes
purpose: Mesh mode shows repeat transitions and extractions that flood the GPU/validation; throttle to stable cadence.

steps.detail: Run updateCoarseDensityGrid + generateCoarseMipChain every N frames (e.g., N=4) when camera/light not significantly changed; otherwise run immediately.
Run extractIsoSurfaceShells every M frames (e.g., M=60) or on significant density change; skip if previous TLAS is still building.
Aggregate 'Starting coarse density update' logs into a single line per burst.

acceptance: No freeze/exits after a few frames
